chain_words.nuance: to increase in size or extent over time
to change gradually into a more complex form
to bring something to a more advanced stage
to move something forward with purpose
to speed up the pace of progress dramatically

explanation: These words all describe the process of progress, from gradual growth to a sharply accelerated pace of change.

usage_notes.difference: 'Evolve' describes gradual change over time, often without a conscious plan; 'develop' describes deliberate work to bring something to a more advanced state.
